metadata.title: Mpinger Groups — Precision Manufacturing, Peat-Free Substrates & Enterprise AI
metadata.description: Indo-German group delivering CNC precision components, peat-free coir substrates, compact construction machinery and enterprise AI. Indian scale, German specification.
metadata.contactDescription: Start a conversation with Mpinger Groups about engineering, growing media, machinery or enterprise AI.

group.title: German standards. Indian scale.
group.description: Four specialist companies under one group: precision machined components, peat-free growing media, compact construction machinery and enterprise AI — manufactured at Indian scale, specified and quality-assured from Hannover.

kokosflora.title: Peat-free growing media, made from coconut husk.
kokosflora.description: Kokosflora turns coconut husk — a by-product of food agriculture — into renewable coir substrate for professional horticulture. Produced in India, warehoused in Germany for short EU lead times.

engineering.title: Precision components, machined to European tolerance.
engineering.description: The group's founding business. mpinger delivers CNC-turned and milled parts, castings, sheet metal and surface finishing from Indian production to European industry — with Hanox supplying compact construction machinery to the same standard.

technology.title: Enterprise AI, past the pilot stage.
technology.description: mpasys takes AI from proof-of-concept to systems people actually use — data foundations, honest evaluation, and integration into the workflows a business already runs on.

contact.title: Bring us the hard part.
contact.description: Whether it is a component that needs to hold tolerance, a substrate that needs to travel well, or an AI system that needs to work in the real world, start with the brief.
